methodologyNotes: Covers residential and light-commercial ceiling fans sold at a published US MSRP or typical street price in USD. Includes indoor, damp-rated, and wet-rated models; excludes portable/pedestal fans, industrial HVLS fans over 84 in, and bare motor-only assemblies. bladeSpanInches is blade sweep (diameter) in inches. bladeCount is the number of blades. motorType is an enum: 'dc' (brushless DC) or 'ac'. airflowCfm is manufacturer-rated maximum airflow at highest speed in cubic feet per minute; null if not disclosed. airflowEfficiencyCfmPerWatt is the Energy Star airflow-efficiency figure (CFM per watt) at high speed; null if not disclosed. powerConsumptionWatts is motor power draw at high speed in watts, excluding any light kit; null if not disclosed. speedCount is the number of discrete forward speed settings. connectivity is the highest built-in control tier as an enum: 'wifi' (native Wi-Fi/app/voice), 'rf-remote' (handheld/wall RF or IR remote), or 'pull-chain'. lightKit is an enum: 'integrated-led', 'optional', or 'none'. locationRating is the UL listing as an enum: 'dry', 'damp', or 'wet'. noiseLevelDb is rated sound level at high speed in dBA; null if not disclosed. Price is US MSRP or typical retail in USD.

products.name: Emerson Midway Eco CF955 54"
products.priceNote: US MSRP from the manufacturer's archived CF955 Midway Eco product page, which lists "Price $533.99 to $554.99" (price varies by housing finish); $533.99 is the base of that stated range. No live retail price was available for verbatim sourcing: the Amazon CF955BS listing shows "Currently unavailable" and eBay shows the item "Currently sold out."
products.provenance: The archived Emerson manufacturer product page (ceilingfans.emerson.com, SKU CF955 "Midway Eco") confirms this exact model: 54" fan span, five airfoil blades, a 6-speed LED remote control with receiver, the EcoMotor, Energy Star rating, and an integrated fluorescent light fixture using four 13-watt GU24 bulbs; it lists the manufacturer price as "Price $533.99 to $554.99" by finish, so $533.99 (base of the range) is used. The Amazon listing for CF955BS (Collection "MIDWAY ECO", Model Number CF955BS — the brushed-steel finish of the same base fan) corroborates 54", 5 blades, DC motor, 6 speeds, 17.5 watts, and "Air Flow Capacity 6206 Cubic Feet Per Minute," and confirms the fluorescent (non-LED) light kit, establishing this is the fluorescent CF955 and not the LED CF955L variant. Both Amazon and eBay showed the item unavailable/sold out with no live retail price, so the manufacturer MSRP was used; lightKit is null because the integrated fixture is fluorescent (does not match the 'integrated-led' enum), and locationRating/noiseLevelDb/airflowEfficiency were not explicitly stated on any fetched page.
